page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on a KVM hypervisor. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs. The instance is powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. With a configuration of one thread per core, it provides dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met using external block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps.

Qualitatively, the dedicated core allocation and balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer a predictable performance profile for enterprise workloads, avoiding resource contention. The ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is suited for general-purpose applications, including application servers, web serving, containerized microservices, and CI/CD pipelines that require consistent CPU performance and moderate memory capacity.
